Privacy policy

Updated 12 September 2026

Mural keeps your learning history on your device. Conversations still need an AI provider to work, and our website stores the email you submit when you request access. This policy explains those different data flows and the choices you have.

Who is responsible

Mural is operated by Hackmamba Inc., a company incorporated in the United States. We are responsible for the personal information we collect to operate the Mural website, handle access requests, and respond to support enquiries. Contact us at hi@hackmamba.io about this policy or your information.

This policy covers mural.chat and the current Mural app provided by us. If you run a modified or independently hosted copy of the open-source software, that operator is responsible for its own practices.

Your conversations and learning history

The current app uses an OpenAI API key that you provide. A Mural account is not required. Conversation transcripts, vocabulary, recall estimates, learning progress, and preferences are saved on your device. We do not receive a copy of that learning history on Mural's servers. Mural does not save raw conversation audio to its local learning archive.

Your API key is held in the device's Keychain and sent to OpenAI to authorise requests. It is not sent to Mural's servers or included in a learning-data export.

When you agree to AI processing and start a conversation, your microphone audio and the context needed for that conversation go directly from the app to OpenAI. Relevant text is also sent for subtitles, word explanations, learning feedback, and topic research. Finishing a conversation can trigger a final review of its transcript to update your local learning record. If you ask for a current topic, OpenAI may use its web-search service to research the request.

OpenAI processes these requests through your provider account, under its terms and account settings. Its current API documentation says API data is not used for model training by default unless you opt in. Default abuse-monitoring records may retain content for up to 30 days, with exceptions for legal requirements. Mural requests that application storage be disabled where the API supports it; this does not turn off all provider retention. See OpenAI's data controls and privacy policy.

Share only what you want processed by the AI provider. Avoid including another person's private information without permission. Local storage also depends on your device security and any device backups or exported files you choose to keep.

When you request access

The website asks for your email address so we can contact you about access to Mural. We store that address, the time of your latest request, the version of the consent wording you accepted, and the fact that the request came from the website. Repeating a request refreshes its date. The form gives the same success message for a new address and one already on the list, so it does not reveal who has requested access.

Submitting the form does not create an app account. There is no automatic email sequence. We may send an access invitation and messages needed to help you set it up. Your request does not subscribe you to a newsletter, advertising, or unrelated product updates.

Providing your email is optional. Without it, we cannot send you an invitation, but you can still browse the website and use the publicly available source code. You can withdraw your request at any time by emailing hi@hackmamba.io from the address you submitted.

Website, security, and support information

Cloudflare delivers and protects the website. It processes network and request information, such as IP addresses and technical details needed to deliver pages, detect threats, and maintain the service. Mural does not run advertising trackers or marketing analytics scripts.

To limit repeated access requests, our backend temporarily counts requests using a protected identifier derived from a network address. The stored counter does not contain the raw IP address, and the identifier changes each day. We do not use it to build a browsing profile. Our application does not keep raw access-request IP addresses in its database or request logs. Infrastructure providers may process network information for their own delivery and security functions.

If you contact support, we receive your email address, your message, and any attachments or information you choose to send. Please do not send API keys, payment credentials, or a full conversation export when a short description will explain the problem.

Why we use this information

We use the information described above to provide the features you request, manage access invitations, answer questions, protect the service, and meet applicable legal obligations. Where European or UK data-protection law applies, our bases for processing are:

  • Your consent for retaining an access request and contacting you about that request. You may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing.
  • Providing the service you request for processing necessary to deliver a feature or respond to a service request.
  • Our legitimate interests in keeping the website available, preventing abuse, and resolving general support enquiries, subject to your rights and interests.
  • Legal obligations when a law requires us to retain or disclose particular information.

Mural uses AI to suggest conversation difficulty and estimate word recall. Those are practice aids. We do not use them to make decisions about employment, admission, credit, or other matters with legal or similarly significant effects on you.

Who receives information and where

Access-request records are stored in a PostgreSQL database on our Hetzner-hosted server in Germany. Cloudflare provides website delivery and security. Our email service providers process messages sent to and from support. OpenAI receives the app's AI requests as described above. These providers receive information needed for their respective roles. Their relevant policies include Cloudflare's privacy policy and Hetzner's privacy policy.

We do not sell your personal information or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising. We may disclose limited information when required by law, to respond to a valid legal request, or when reasonably necessary to protect people, rights, or the service. A corporate transaction could involve transferring information to a successor, subject to applicable law and continued privacy obligations.

Mural is operated by a US-incorporated company, and our providers operate internationally. Information may be accessed or processed outside your country, including in the United States. Hosting the access-request database in Germany does not mean every service involved processes information only in Europe. Provider policies explain their processing locations and transfer arrangements. Contact us for information about transfers and safeguards relevant to information we hold about you.

How long information is kept

  • Learning data: stays in the app until you delete it or replace it through an import. You control any separate exports or device backups.
  • Access requests: are kept for up to 12 months after your latest request, unless you withdraw sooner. We also remove requests when they are no longer needed to arrange access.
  • Abuse-prevention counters: identifiers in the active database expire within two hours and are removed by routine cleanup. Cleanup normally runs every 15 minutes while the service is operating. Non-identifying totals may remain for up to 48 hours.
  • Support correspondence: is kept while needed to answer the enquiry and deal with related issues. We may retain relevant parts longer where needed for a legal obligation or a dispute.
  • Backups: encrypted database backups on our server are retained for 14 days. Hosting-provider backups follow the provider's backup rotation and may include expired records or security counters. A deleted record may remain in a protected backup until that backup expires; it is not used for new invitations. If a backup is restored, deletions must be reapplied before the restored list is used.

OpenAI and other providers have their own retention rules. Deleting data in Mural does not recall information already processed by a provider or delete copies you saved elsewhere.

Your choices and rights

In the app, you can export your learning archive, import it on another device, delete local learning data, or remove your API key. You can stop an AI conversation and control microphone permission in iOS Settings. Removing a key prevents new authorised requests from the app; it does not revoke the key at OpenAI. Revoke a compromised key in your provider account.

Depending on where you live and the law that applies, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or receive a portable copy of personal information we hold; restrict or object to its use; withdraw consent; or appeal a decision about a rights request. You may also complain to the relevant data-protection authority. We do not penalise you for exercising rights protected by law.

Send requests to hi@hackmamba.io. We may ask for information reasonably needed to verify that a request is yours, and will respond within the period required by applicable law. We cannot retrieve your on-device learning archive for you because we do not hold a server copy. Requests concerning information held independently by OpenAI or Apple may also need to be made to that provider.

Security and younger users

We use measures appropriate to the information we handle, including encrypted connections, restricted backend access, and encrypted database backups. The app uses iOS protections for local files and Keychain credentials. No service or device can promise complete security.

Mural is a general-audience language-practice service and does not offer child accounts or a parental-consent system. Users must meet the eligibility requirements in our terms and those of the AI service they use. We do not knowingly collect children's information where required parental permission has not been obtained. If you believe a child has submitted personal information to us in those circumstances, contact us so we can review and remove it as required.

Future features and policy changes

Mural account signup, hosted trial minutes, and paid credits are not active in the current app. We will explain their data collection and update this policy before enabling them. An access request is not consent to future billing, account creation, or marketing.

We will update the date above when this policy changes. If a change materially affects how we use your information, we will provide a notice in the app or on the website before it takes effect where required. We will ask for a new choice where a change requires your consent.
